Browser video trimming uses @ffmpeg/ffmpeg 0.12.15 (MIT) and unmodified
@ffmpeg/core 0.12.10 (GPL-2.0-or-later). The core runs in a separate web worker.

Upstream source, build scripts and dependency versions:
https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm/tree/v0.12.10
https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm
https://ffmpeg.org/download.html
License text: https://www.gnu.org/licenses/old-licenses/gpl-2.0.txt

Core binaries are copied from the pinned npm package at build time without
modification. The WASM binary is split into two byte ranges for static hosting
and reassembled identically before execution. No user media is sent to any
third-party trimming service. Keep this attribution when redistributing.
